title: job.file
description: One file of a job started, or ended as processed, skipped (its output was already there, or it is not a video) or failed. file is its index in the job's files, from 0. Every other event about a file comes between its started and its ending; a file paused or cancelled part way has no ending, and a resumed one starts again. output is the finished file, for processed, and for skipped when the skip was because that output is already there.
